Lina: Heads-up: onboarding 'sable-hybrid-13b' shows inconsistent rotary behavior after llama->gemma conversion + GPTQ q4_0. Minimal repro and notes below.

Lina: Repro steps:
```bash
python convert.py --src ckpt/sable --dst sable-hybrid --out sable.pt
python quantize.py --model sable.pt --scheme q4_0 --out sable.q4 --checksums
python tiny_eval.py --model sable.q4 --prompt \"Who discovered penicillin?\" --max-tokens 10 --dump-logits --dump-kv
```
Symptoms: occasional token glue ("AlexanderFleming") and head-specific phase offsets in attention heatmaps. Some runs also emit duplicate EOS.

Marco: Paste tokenized ids + rotary tensor shapes pre/post quant please, and the checksums.

Lina: Dump: 
```nids: [600, 71, 402, 2]
tokens: [\"Who\", \"discovered\", \"penicillin\", \"</s>\"]
q4_out_tokens: [\"Whodiscovered\", \"penicillin\", \"</s>\"]
rotary_shape_pre: [32, 64]
rotary_meta_post: [2048]  # flattened
checksums: rotary_pre=0x1a2b3c4d rotary_post=0xdeadbeef
```

Priya: That flattening is the red flag. Looks like the converter or packer collapsed (heads, head_dim) -> (head_dim,) before quantization, which loses per-head frequencies. Also run tokenizer-scan — sometimes Unicode normalization differences create merged byte-seqs causing glue.

Dev: Reproduced locally. Converter had a fastpath that calls `.flatten()` when packing contiguous rotary arrays; if the view was broadcastable it writes shape_meta incorrectly. Short-term: I wrote a small runtime rebuild that detects 1D rotary tensor and reconstructs per-head inv_freq with compute_inv_freq(head_dim, base) and reshapes to (num_heads, head_dim).

Marco: Does the rebuild fix lexicon smoke?

Dev: On a quick run lexicon smoke failures dropped 14->3. Token alignment and logits match FP16 within tolerance on short prompts. Perf hit ~+1.7ms/token for CPU runtime.

Priya: Also found tokenizer differences: pre-convert tokenizer normalized to NFC; artifact tokenizer had mixed normalization. tokenizer-scan flagged duplicate byte-seq mappings for bytes 0xC3 0xA9 (é) mapped twice due to inconsistent normalization. We should enforce `tokenizer.normalize('NFC')` in conversion pipeline and fail conversion if duplicates detected.

Lina: eval-bot: lexicon/regression run on sable.q4 -> 3/432 failures. Report: https://internal/reports/1755559999

ci-bot: quant artifact build #7012 for sable-hybrid-13b (q4_0) uploaded: s3://redwood-quant/sable-hybrid/7012/sable.q4 (rotary_crc=0xdeadbeef)

Marco: Two remediation tracks: 1) fix converter/packer to preserve shape and metadata; 2) runtime fallback (keeps us safe while we fix converter). Also add quant-checksum asserts that compare crc32 of tensor content and expected shape meta.

Priya: I'll add the tokenizer gate: enforce NFC and a duplicate-byte-seq check. If duplicates found, converter should abort with clear remediation steps. Also add unit test with known problematic vocab.

Dev: I'll open a WIP PR with runtime fallback + a lightweight telemetry counter when fallback triggers so we can measure how often converted artifacts need it. Also add a param-layout check in the quantizer that asserts rotary shape != flattened.

Marco: For quant experiments, try q3_k and q5_0 on a small shard to see if group size prevents the flattening (we've seen q3_k sometimes preserve shape). Capture `--param-layout` diffs. If q3_k preserves shape, we can temporarily prefer it for affected model families.

Lina: I kicked a q3_k job on 1% shard overnight. Early results: q3_k artifact kept rotary shape meta [32,64] and lexicon smoke reduced to 1/432 failure. I'll post full logs.

Dev: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/10456 (WIP) includes `rotary_rebuild_fallback`, telemetry 'rotary_rebuild_count', and a unit test `tests/test_rotary_rebuild.py`.

Priya: I'll add converter change and tokenizer-normalization patch. Also adding a converter self-check that compares pre/post crc for rotary tensor and emits an error if shapes mismatch.

Marco: Assign owners: Lina (onboarding + artifact regen), Dev (PR + telemetry), Priya (tokenizer gate + converter guard), me (quant shard experiments). We'll coordinate to merge fallback quickly, then revert when converter fixed.

Lina: Thanks everyone  will update thread with q3_k results and PR status. :coffee:
